diagnose.label: Diagnostic Test
diagnose.title: Find your starting point
diagnose.lead: A diagnostic test that locates your position in the concept graph using as few questions as possible.
diagnose.step1: The concept graph is sorted topologically: the diagnostic starts at the midpoint.
diagnose.step2: Each concept is probed with multiple questions at varying difficulty to get a reliable estimate.
diagnose.step3: Correct answers within the time limit move the probe forward toward harder concepts.
diagnose.step4: Incorrect or slow answers move backward toward foundational material.
diagnose.step5: The diagnostic records a mastery estimate for every concept passed through.
diagnose.retake: You can retake the diagnostic test at any time: retaking never deletes progress, and Mathua always keeps the most optimistic estimate.

plan.label: Learning planner
plan.title: Plan your learning
plan.saved: Plan saved. A pace is not a starting point — use the diagnostic below to find out which concept you belong at.
plan.nextBody: A plan sets how much you study per day. It does not say where to begin: the diagnostic measures what you already know, then starts you at the right concept.

planner.infeasible: Above 3× your recent pace — extend the deadline or raise daily effort gradually.
planner.paceMeasured: At your recent pace ({rate} XP/day, {active}/{days} active days).
planner.paceNone: No history yet — assuming you hit your target every day.
planner.freshStart: Fresh start — complete a few questions and your estimate will sharpen. No behind-schedule figure until a new baseline lands.

dailyGoal.heading: Daily XP target · currently {current}/day
dailyGoal.note: XP is earned per question, sized by how much work that question takes (1-5 XP), so the number of questions a day varies by topic. Changing your target never moves quiz eligibility or mastery.
